reviews.text:
Integrity and Quality. Key words when dealing with Shawn Powell and Lone Star Pool & Patio. I consulted with 3 other companies before I settled on Lone Star. One company completely everything I said I wanted and dictated the pool they wanted to build. Needless to say they were off the list.
My build was a complete collaboration effort. They listened to what I wanted and advised and recommended with solid reasoning when offering an alternative.
I could not have been happier with the build process, which can be stressful, and the end result.
Shawn and crew were on top of the build every step of the way and were prompt to take care of any concerns I had.
It’s been a year and we’re still extremely happy. The only issue we had with a valve motor was taken care of within hours.
If you want attention to detail and a quality product. They are great!
reviews.author: James Phillips

reviews.text:
ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY AFTER INITIAL WORK

After experiencing failure after a few months of the initial work, and attempting for 3 years to contact Shawn/Lonestar Pools and have warranty repairs, we have concluded the above statement to  be more than true. We feel like we gave him more than ample time to rectify the multiple issues.
(work done BEFORE Covid)

Buyer beware!
reviews.author: Holly Hester Richardson

reviews.text: Did a great job on our pool resurfacing that we can tell so far. The deck that they removed and replaced with stamped concrete not so much. The deck has cracked all over! It’s a mess! Our prior deck they removed had 1 cracked spot in it after 18 years. This deck tons of cracks after 2 years. Yes we reached out and they take zero responsibility! I was shocked since Shawn seemed so honest. Guess next time I will go with a big band that backs their workmanship and product.
reviews.author: Gina Kilgore

reviews.text: Shawn and his crew managed to get a little early start on a replacing the tile and and replastering my pool and hot tub in early December. They managed to wrap up the project in a couple of days and the results were better than I had any reason to expect. They were very professional, cleaned everything up and all, in all, did an excellent job. I would recommend them to anyone.
reviews.author: Edward Reinauer

reviews.text: Shawn upgraded our plaster, mastic, and fixed our stone.  Great to work with.  Prompt and clear when communicating.  Went out of his way to ensure we had all our questions answered ahead of the project.  Set expectations and adhered to them, getting the job done quickly and on time.  Workmanship was fantastic.  Very happy with Lone Star.
reviews.author: Jeremy Kaster

reviews.text: Shawn resurfaced our pool, installed new concrete decking and resurfaced existing decking, and built a new arbor.  We couldn't be happier with the results - it all looks great!  The work was done quickly and professionally and all of our concerns were addressed cheerfully.  Great job.
reviews.author: Pat Tovery

reviews.text: After they finished, we still couldn’t use our pool for three weeks, turned green, when I brought it to his attention and I was not so polite the kid told me I could not walk one day in his shoes, whatever that means beware
reviews.author: brock west

reviews.text: Shawn's a great guy and we couldn't be happier with his company!
reviews.author: Robin Hebert
